#filmphotography

I've started something.
Tomorrow, I'll be putting the AGO Processor into operation using a roll of Tri-X 320 that expired in 2020.

Today, for the first time in ages, I met up with a photographer friend of mine. The Mamiya and I had a great time at the Zollhafen in Mainz. My friend brought his OM-1. Some Kodak Tri-X black-and-white film whose expiry date had passed in 2020 was used in the process.

The next step in getting back into black-and-white film development with Rodinal after a two-year break: I’m going to shoot a good old test roll. I hope to see if the developer still works. #filmphotography

After quite a long break, I did a quick stock-take in my darkroom today. I still have plenty of all the materials. Do photochemical supplies have an expiry date? Does anyone have any experience with this? #filmphotography
